description: This file defines the SystemMenuBlock class for Drupal, implementing a configurable menu block with methods for form handling, building the menu, cache management, and active trail logic.

classes.name: SystemMenuBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a configurable menu block with form options, cache management, and menu rendering logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the menu tree and active trail services.

methods.name: blockForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for the menu block.

methods.name: processMenuLevelParents
methods.description: Processes form element parents for menu levels.

methods.name: blockSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the block configuration form.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the menu tree based on configuration and returns the render array.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default configuration for the block.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags for the block, including menu configuration.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts, including active trail context if applicable.

methods.name: createPlaceholder
methods.description: Indicates whether the block can be a placeholder.

methods.name: shouldSetActiveTrail
methods.description: Determines if the active trail should be set based on configuration.
